## Download

Download the **JobMech-…-win-x64.zip** below, unzip it anywhere and start `JobMech.exe`. Nothing is installed.

- Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit) with the Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime, which Windows 11 and up-to-date Windows 10 already have.
- The program is not code-signed, so SmartScreen may ask for confirmation on first start.
- Already using JobMech? Your data stays where it is and this version finds it. If your older copy kept its data in a `data` folder next to the program, choose **I already have JobMech data** on the first screen (or **Settings, Data and about, Restore**) and pick that folder.

This build was made by GitHub Actions from the tagged source, after the full test run passed.
